image_description: An underwater shot of a hammerhead shark swimming diagonally from top-left to bottom-right. The shark's distinctive cephalofoil (hammer-shaped head) is clearly visible, with eyes at the tips. The body is greyish-brown on top and lighter underneath. A tall dorsal fin and pectoral fins are visible. The background is dark blue water with some particulate matter and a faint reflection or another fish in the lower right.
